summary: Docebo Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a substantial issuer bid to repurchase up to US$70,000,000 of its common shares at US$20.40 per share. The offer is not conditional on any minimum tender; if oversubscribed, purchases will be pro-rated, except odd-lot holders. The board believes the share price undervalues the business. The company intends to fund the bid with cash on hand and a draw on its increased credit facility (to $150M). Intercap, owning 63.9%, intends to maintain its ownership percentage. Canaccord Genuity Corp. is financial advisor, TSX Trust Company is depositary. Watch for final take-up level and any proration; the bid is a capital return mechanism with no premium over market.
